title: Masked Block-Cipher Costs Across Field Types
summary: Software and hardware cost tradeoffs between prime-field and binary-extension-field masked block-cipher implementations remain unresolved.

formal_statement.body: Determine and compare the software and hardware implementation cost of masked block-cipher operations when implemented in prime fields rather than in binary extension fields.

scope.domain: Masked block-cipher implementation complexity across prime and binary extension fields.
parameters: Arithmetic domain: distinguishes prime fields from binary extension fields
Implementation setting: distinguishes software costs from hardware costs
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine and compare the software and hardware implementation costs of masked block-cipher operations in the two arithmetic domains.

citations.label: Effective and Efficient Masking with Low Noise using Small-Mersenne-Prime Ciphers

progress.summary: The source presents this as an explicit practical open question in its discussion of masking in low-noise settings, requesting cost comparisons for both software and hardware.
